items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: They had Harlan Leonard Band, and some local acts.

ctx.x: Just one performance. I went down there. It was sponsored by the local newspapers and the local NAACP, and they had quite a show. They had Harlan Leonard Band, and some local acts.
Okay, I guess you were on the road a lot at that time?
